clues.text: As cloaks and cut branches covered the road to Jerusalem, crowds ahead of Jesus and behind Him shouted this.
Children shouted this in Jerusalem's temple courts, and the chief priests and scribes grew indignant.
When priests complained about children shouting this, Jesus replied that God ordained praise from the mouths of infants.
Crowds following Jesus into Jerusalem cried this word out to the Son of David.
As Jesus rode the colt, people shouted this along with a blessing on the coming kingdom of their father David.
Along the road into Jerusalem, the people cried this word followed by "in the highest."
A crowd at the feast took palm branches, went out to meet Jesus, and shouted this before blessing Israel's King.
